hit: A low-resolution digital photo taken on a 2005 Sony CyberShot

hit: contrast between warm interior tones and cold blue snowy exterior

hit: exploded view with inner mechanics revealed, outer shell hovering above core, micro screws and components suspended
why: Describe the parts as floating layers and any product becomes a clean exploded diagram.

hit: A Japanese Edo-period Ukiyo-e woodblock print

hit: Flavor theme: 【{argument name="flavor theme" default="Strawberry"}】

hit: oversized DJ setup

hit: warm tungsten room light from above/side creating soft golden highlights on hair curls and skin

hit: watercolor style, on which all federal states are labeled in ballpoint pen

hit: bathed in bright, harsh sunlight, creating strong shadows and high contrast

hit: Soft macaron color palette

hit: strong chiaroscuro lighting to create a high-fashion editorial ambiance

hit: ultra-high-fidelity 3D isometric miniature models

hit: Warm neon ambient + Direct Phone Flash
